import os
from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import (
    MessageInput,
    DataInput,
    DataFrameInput,
    MessageTextInput,
    Output,
)
from langflow.schema import Data


class AppendToFileComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Append to File"
    description = "Appends input data (Message, Data, or DataFrame) to a specified file."
    icon = "file-add"
    name = "AppendToFile"

    inputs = [
        MessageInput(
            name="message_input",
            display_name="Message Input",
            info="Provide a Message object to append to a file.",
            required=False,
        ),
        DataInput(
            name="data_input",
            display_name="Data Input",
            info="Provide a Data object to append to a file.",
            required=False,
        ),
        DataFrameInput(
            name="dataframe_input",
            display_name="DataFrame Input",
            info="Provide a DataFrame object to append as a CSV file.",
            required=False,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="file_path",
            display_name="File Path",
            info="Specify the file path where the data will be appended.",
            required=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(
            name="status",
            display_name="Status",
            method="append_to_file",
        ),
    ]

    def append_to_file(self) -> Data:
        """Handles appending the provided input to the specified file."""
        file_path = self.file_path
        message_input = self.message_input
        data_input = self.data_input
        dataframe_input = self.dataframe_input

        # Ensure at least one input type is provided
        if not any([message_input, data_input, dataframe_input]):
            error_message = "No valid input provided. Please provide a Message, Data, or DataFrame input."
            self.status = error_message
            return Data(data={"error": error_message})

        try:
            # Determine the content to append based on input type
            if message_input:
                content = message_input.text  # Correctly handle Message objects
            elif data_input:
                content = data_input.data if isinstance(data_input.data, str) else str(data_input.data)
            elif dataframe_input:
                # Convert DataFrame to CSV format
                content = dataframe_input.data.to_csv(index=False)

            # Ensure the directory exists
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(file_path), exist_ok=True)

            # Append content to the specified file
            with open(file_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as file:  # Open in append mode
                file.write(content + "\n")  # Add a newline for separation

            success_message = f"Data successfully appended to {file_path}."
            self.status = success_message
            return Data(data={"message": success_message})

        except Exception as e:
            error_message = f"Failed to append data to file: {e}"
            self.status = error_message
            return Data(data={"error": error_message})
